additional_concerns: The exposure predicate delegates asset identification and measurement to supplied facts. The formula alone does not establish that direct and indirect exposures, non-exhaustive instrument examples, or look-through calculations were assessed correctly.

Footnote 7 states: “In cases where the Fund’s aggregate direct and indirect exposures to private market assets are less than 50% of the Fund’s NAV.” The designation route must remain available below 50%. The OR preserves that possibility; the listed discretionary factors do not themselves establish a designation.

Assessment-time and operative-designation concepts implement the typed question, but the circular supplies no persistence, revocation, temporary-crossing or declassification rule. A false result cannot establish non-complex status.

The global conflict-blocking rule can prevent a result even when an independently established route would suffice. This is a declared evidence-handling restriction, not a requirement established by the circular.
The three supplied dependency IDs have no source hashes or identifying metadata. None can reliably be matched to a particular missing authority.
The LAF circular referenced in footnote 6 would be needed to assess the separate regime governing LAFs; it is not needed merely to preserve the express exclusion here.
